title: Senior Data Analytics Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission: One source of truth for a company that runs on data

As Senior Analytics Engineer, you own voize's company data from the warehouse to the dashboards. You'll be part of our Data & AI function - ensuring the data voize and our AI layer runs on are reliable, safe & scalable. The modern stack (Redshift, dbt, Fivetran, Lightdash) is already live: you make it rock-solid and turn it into the single source of truth the whole company runs on, from ARR to product adoption. As our first dedicated analytics hire, you partner directly with Finance, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success, turning their questions into numbers everyone trusts.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Model company data in dbt on Redshift: layered, tested, documented models built to outlive you

  • Ship and run the company KPI dashboard in Lightdash, plus self-serve analytics for every team

  • Own metric modeling and propose the definitions the whole company runs on. Sign-off sits with data leadership, and you make every number defensible

  • Keep the ingestion layer running day to day (Fivetran connectors, existing ETL jobs), in close coordination with engineering

  • Act as a partner to our teams and turn ambiguous business questions from Finance, RevOps, Product, and CS into trusted, self-serve answers

  • Shape the data foundation before the function scales. As a Head of (Internal) Data & AI and a further Engineers join, you set the standards they inherit and go deeper on the architecture the whole company trusts.

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • 4+ years owning analytics from the warehouse onwards (modelling, reporting, BI) in production, ideally as an early or founding data hire

  • Deep SQL above all, plus strong dbt (layered models, tests, CI, semantic / metric layers)

  • A cloud data warehouse in production (Redshift ideal; Snowflake or BigQuery with willingness to switch) and a BI tool people actually use

  • Business-facing autonomy: you partner with non-technical stakeholders, propose and defend metric definitions, and ship without waiting for a data team to form around you

  • You document, test, and monitor by default, and finishing the 10% that makes a model trustworthy

  • You know how to leverage AI, you have a track record of automating & building workflows with AI.

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

  • Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses

  • You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

  • Experience assessing business, operational and technical dependencies and impacts

  • Strong track record in creating business requirements, functional specifications, interface specifications and implementation-ready documentation

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a high level of attention to detail

  • Understanding of market data, reference data and relevant regulatory considerations

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.
